name: Dietzenbach (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Dietzenbach (a white bend with a blue wavy band and grapes on red).
history: The flag was approved for the then municipality of Dietzenbach by the Hessian Minister of the Interior on 10 November 1958, with the arms on the broad yellow middle stripe of the blue-yellow-blue cloth.

features.role: Dietzenbach arms — bend with wavy band and grapes on red
